newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish 1996 inflation seen 1.0 pct - budget leak.
newsitem.headline: Swedish 1996 inflation seen 1.0 pct - budget leak.

text.p: Swedish inflation will be 1.0 percent in full year 1996 and 2.2 percent in 1997, Swedish television said, quoting from a leaked copy of the government's state budget which is due to be presented on Friday.
Sweden's TV2 said GDP growth would be 1.6 percent in 1996 and 2.3 percent in 1997.

Unemployment would total 7.7 percent of the workforce in 1996, falling to 6.9 percent in 1997, according to the leaked document. The television station said total open unemployment would be 12.7 percent in 1996 and 12.3 percent in 1997.
